result.text:
🚨 Another week, another critical vulnerability addressed in PHP.

CVE-2026-111497 (Brotli) scores 9.2 CVSS.

PHP released updated Windows builds today (Oct-26) to address the vulnerability in its bundled Brotli library.

Linux installations may also be exposed through vulnerable system Brotli dependencies, which require separate updates.

https://t.co/IbxsXBvhI7

#php #cybersecurity
